# <span id="aanchor64"></span> Dashboard Manager

Use the Dashboard Manager to configure the following dashboard tools (widgets):

- [Quick Launch Tiles](Dashboard%20Manager_Quick%20Launch.md)
- ["Did you know?" Tips](Dashboard%20Manager_DYK.md)
- [Exception Resolver Widget](Dashboard%20Manager_Exception%20Resolver.md)
- [Gain/Loss Balance Widget](Dashboard%20Manager_Gain-Loss%20Balance%20Tool.md)

<div class="procedure">

To configure your Dashboard items: 

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Dashboard Manager**.
2.  Click each item to access the corresponding settings screens.
